name: <spec name this map verifies>

spec.name: <spec name>
spec.version: <integer, the spec version this map is pinned to>
spec.commit: <hash the spec was frozen at; a draft pin is recorded as allow_draft on the launch>

fixture: <path to the fixture the checks run against>
allowed_paths: <glob a unit may write; non-empty when frozen>
locked_paths: <glob no edit may touch during a run; non-empty when frozen>
run_all: <one command that runs every check, for a human at a terminal>

baseline.note: <what the baseline run showed, one line>

checks.status: <ok | new | changed; every check is ok in v1>
checks.kind: <structural | behavioural | artefact | invariant | project-rule | statistical | judged>
checks.class: <deterministic | property | statistical | judged; required when the spec is agent-shaped>
checks.name: <short name for the check>
covers: <spec node id this check proves, or 'scope'>
checks.command: <command run as /bin/sh -c from the launch root; never shown to a worker>
checks.gate_only: <boolean; true runs it under fc check all and the stop gate only>

baseline.expect: <pass|fail: what this check should do before the work, and why>
baseline.observed: <pass|fail|error: the first output line of the baseline run; its first word matches expect when frozen>

checks.note: <required when this check is not ok>

retired.at: <integer version this check was retired in>
